scope: Independent velocity derivative interface and finite-difference reference oracle; no production-candidate modification.

open_pr_collision_check.pr_1: production constrained candidate/optimizer/validation lane; intentionally not modified
open_pr_collision_check.pr_2: basis-growth capacity experiment; intentionally not duplicated

commands_and_actual_results.scope: isolated local copy of the new module/test on the main baseline API surface

checks.manufactured_field: divergence-free polynomial with exact spatial first/second and time derivatives
checks.hessian: selected mixed/diagonal entries matched; numerical Hessian exactly symmetrized
checks.divergence: matched zero within stated test tolerance
checks.invalid_inputs: malformed shapes, NaN, bool/nonpositive steps, bad velocity shape and missing velocity method fail closed

remaining_limitations: CR003 is not complete; PR #1 owns the production candidate implementation.
The new derivative oracle uses central finite differences and is a validation reference, not the final analytic/AD production derivative path.
The production candidate must later implement velocity_derivatives(points,time) and be compared against this oracle on interior held-out points.
Symmetric stencils require callers to stay away from spatial/chart/time boundaries.
No PDE residual acceptance, paper-exact reconstruction, or blow-up claim follows from these tests.
